observations.posthog_connection: Desktop Workspace: The Desktop Workspace uses this service to maintain a consistent browser tab state. This chunk changes the default tab URL and the tab closing behavior, potentially changing the user's browser experience. The change also removes the ability to close a tab without specifying a replacement tab, and the default tab URL is now used instead of the previous one.
